description: Guided rear-end report with sourced policy uncertainty, pending evidence, and staff resolution.

turns.input: Someone hit the back of my car on Queen Street. The bumper is damaged and I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do now.
No one was hurt. We moved both cars out of traffic and the scene is safe.
It happened at about 5:30 pm today.
The police report will be ready next week.

staff_resolution.customer_update: A claims specialist reviewed the collision wording. Your report can continue, and you can add the police report when it becomes available.
